name: SignNow
label: SignNow API — documents and invites
description: SignNow API at https://api.signnow.com. Docs: https://docs.signnow.com/. document_upload is multipart file. invite_send uses to/from/subject. Bearer access_token minted outside this node. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log access_token. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets on this port.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. Accepted: document_upload, invite_send, document_get, document_download, template_create, listen. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: document_id
schema.description: Document id for invite_send / document_get / document_download / template_create.

schema.label: to
schema.description: invite_send signers. Official array of {email, role, order, auth_method}. Required. A single email string is also accepted by some accounts.

schema.label: from
schema.description: invite_send from email (account sender). Example: contracts@example.com.

schema.label: type
schema.description: document_download query type. collapsed | zip | email.

schema.label: document_name
schema.description: Template name for template_create. Required with document_id.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Document file for document_upload (POST /document multipart field file). Required. Platform file block.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status, http_status, data, file?}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Secrets redacted. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Downloaded or converted bytes. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official HTTP verb for this invoke. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: OAuth access token minted outside StudioQuack. StudioQuack secret binding. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
